# Fluxrow

> Creative intelligence agency building AI-powered websites, automations, and operator systems for businesses. Daily AI news in PT and EN.

Fluxrow combines design, engineering, and AI to ship production systems: marketing sites, conversational agents, internal dashboards, and the AI Operator Kit (bilingual playbook for solo operators). The Fluxrow blog publishes a new article every day on AI, Lovable, Claude, and automation.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Agency overview, services, cases, and process.
- [Agência](/agencia): Services, methodology, and engagement.
- [Produtos](/produtos): Product hub.
- [AI Operator Kit](/produtos/ai-operator-kit): Bilingual practitioner kit (PT + EN).
- [Conteúdos](/conteudos): Long-form guides on AI, Lovable, Claude, prompts, automation.
- [Blog](/blog): Daily AI news, analysis and tutorials (PT). EN version at /blog?lang=en.
- [Contato](/contato): Contact form and direct channels.
- [Política de Privacidade](/politica-de-privacidade): LGPD privacy policy.
- [Termos de Uso](/termos-de-uso): Terms of service.
